description: Fig. 11 is a single-panel vertical bar chart (no micrograph, no scale bar) showing Vickers microhardness of the austenite matrix in as-rolled Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–xBe low-density steel as a function of beryllium content. The y-axis is printed "Matrix (Austenite) Hardness (HV)" with tick labels at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400 and 500 and dashed horizontal gridlines every 100 HV; the x-axis carries four categorical composition labels in order 0Be, 0.5Be, 1.0Be, 1.5Be. Each bar is colour-coded and annotated with a printed number above an error bar: 0Be (orange) = 415.55 HV, 0.5Be (green, tallest) = 470.97 HV, 1.0Be (purple, shortest) = 398.39 HV, and 1.5Be (yellow) = 407.01 HV. The figure therefore demonstrates a non-monotonic dependence of austenite hardness on Be: a peak at 0.5Be, a drop below the Be-free level at 1.0Be, and a partial recovery at 1.5Be, with error bars that are small relative to these differences. The caption states the plot is the microhardness of the rolled structure; the citing text additionally quotes ferrite hardness values (349.81 HV for 1.0Be, 371.50 HV for 1.5Be) that are not plotted in this figure and are attributed to Table 4.

subfigures.description: Vertical bar chart of matrix (austenite) Vickers hardness vs. Be content for rolled Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–xBe steel; y-axis 'Matrix (Austenite) Hardness (HV)' 0–500 with dashed gridlines every 100 HV; four colour-coded bars with printed values and error bars: 0Be = 415.55 HV (orange), 0.5Be = 470.97 HV (green), 1.0Be = 398.39 HV (purple), 1.5Be = 407.01 HV (yellow).

observations.observation: The figure consists of a single vertical bar chart with linear y-axis labelled 'Matrix (Austenite) Hardness (HV)' and tick labels 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500.
The x-axis shows four categorical composition labels, printed exactly as 0Be, 0.5Be, 1.0Be and 1.5Be, in that left-to-right order.
The bar annotated 415.55 HV is the 0Be composition (orange bar).
The bar annotated 470.97 HV is the 0.5Be composition (green bar) and is the tallest bar in the chart.
The bar annotated 398.39 HV is the 1.0Be composition (purple bar) and is the shortest bar in the chart.
The bar annotated 407.01 HV is the 1.5Be composition (yellow bar).
Every bar carries an error bar; the error magnitudes are small relative to the differences between bars, but no numeric error value is printed.
Dashed horizontal gridlines are drawn at 100 HV intervals across the plot area.
The y-axis label restricts the plotted quantity to the austenite matrix; no ferrite hardness bars appear in the figure.
The caption states the figure shows the microhardness of the Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–xBe rolling structure of the steel.
The citing text states the austenite hardness of rolled 0Be and 0.5Be steel is 415.55 and 470.97 HV respectively, matching the two printed bar values.

The citing text states the austenite hardness of rolled 1.0Be and 1.5Be steel is 398.39 and 407.01 HV, and that the ferrite hardness is 349.81 and 371.50 HV respectively; the ferrite values are not visible in this figure.
The citing text states microhardness of the as-rolled steels was measured by FM-ARS9000 Vickers hardness equipment.
